name: Carolina McLachlan
original_name: キャロライナ・マクラクラン
source:
"Should humans be the strong one... What's your answer, Agent Jace?"

- Origin: Principality of Libyre
- Birthday: June 27
- Height: 152cm
- Three Size: B75(A)/W59/H76
- Likes: History books
- Dislikes: Bad manners in her library
- Will/Gem: "Subhumans Eradicating Silver Bullet" Silvery Buster Barrett

A superior of Souma, belonging from "Twilight Alliance."
Although it might look like she has COMPLETELY THROWN AWAY her disguised appearance, she is still registered as the same old teacher/librarian in Academia.
She is THE master of all masters of dual-wielding handgun techniques.
